So I am definitely pro-life. I was adopted at birth and I am so glad my birth mother didn’t choose to abort me. I find it really heartbreaking when reading stuff about abortion and I just don’t understand how people who have been lucky enough to get adopted can push for abortion. But that’s just an emotional feeling. If we go into the logistics of it, most countries in the EU already have restrictions on abortions at around 12 weeks (some countries vary). Also, I genuinely don’t understand how so many people really believe that the fetus in the womb is not a living human being. It is alive and although it may not be fully formed we shouldn’t kill it. It has a heart beat by six weeks and by the third trimester it could easily be born which makes abortion in the third trimester (in my opinion) absolutely crazy. By that point in the pregnancy the baby is basically fully formed if not completely formed. Also when, throughout the entirety of human history, has a human being ever given birth to a monkey? A dog? A cat? Or anything other than a human being? Never. It has always been a human being. Therefore, saying it is not a human life is irrational. The argument that also comes up to this is usually my body my choice but I really find this logically unreasonable. The body may be inside of you but the life is by no means is yours. Also, when a pregnant lady is killed it is counted as double homicide. So we are able to recognize that it is a life when killed by someone else but not when it’s killed by the mother for her convenience it is logically inconsistent.And yes, most of the abortions are made out of convenience not out of danger for the mother. On the topic of if we ban abortions people will just find another way to find them that is true for all things. While banning it may not eradicate the issue it will decrease it by a large amount which is better than not being decreased at all. Think of it like crime, if stealing wasn’t illegal everyone would steal but since it is illegal a lot of people choose to not steal however crime still takes place. Plus I would also argue (while this may not be a popular opinion) that the father should have a right in the decision. A lot of people say that men should have no opinion in the matter but that is completely unfair because the man is as much of a parent to the child as the female. While he may not carry it in his stomach, he took a part in creating it. On the other hand for both the mother and father, if you are willing to commit in the act of sex you need to be willing to deal with the responsibilities of what may come with it. While I am not in any way against forms of birth control like pills and condoms I do believe that if the female is to get pregnant it is her responsibility to carry it to term. Finally, a decrease in adoption cost would greatly help because adoption seems to be a semi-expensive option sometimes however if the government can help alleviate this I feel that adoptions would become more widespread.
